🫏 New post ready 💬 One-liner · kindness · 🎬 Reel, 10s, warm tune “the stranger who jumped my car lives three states away now, but we still text 'made it' every first frost.” ✍️ Caption
she stood in the sleet with the red cables just to make sure the engine wouldn't die at the lights. the stranger gave me her number at the kerb just to be certain i reached home, and never asked for anything back. send this to the person who still tells you to text the second you pull into the drive. #kindnessmatters #kindnessquotes #randomactsofkindness
